abilities.name: Navigate
abilities.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
abilities.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
abilities.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

abilities.name: Rest
abilities.function: Recover available physical energy at the current position.
abilities.effects: Base recovery 4, modified by actually accessible registered facilities; capped at 40.

abilities.name: Wait
abilities.function: Allow one simulation round to pass at the current position.

abilities.name: Pick up
abilities.function: Transfer a nearby ground stack into personal inventory.
abilities.effects: Requires actual distance within pickup reach; resource:ID means a matching nearby visible ground stack.

abilities.name: Eat
abilities.effects: Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

abilities.name: Gather accessible material
abilities.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
abilities.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
abilities.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

abilities.name: Drop
abilities.function: Place owned units on the ground.
abilities.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack.

abilities.name: Give
abilities.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
abilities.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred.

abilities.name: Message
abilities.function: Send a short message to a currently visible actor.
abilities.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

abilities.name: Learn a public interface
abilities.function: Study an already implemented ability with its declared prerequisites.
abilities.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.
abilities.effects: Implementation does not grant mastery. Already mastered interfaces are reused without new rewards.

abilities.name: Request a capability
abilities.function: Describe an intended function and its conditions, inputs, costs and expected real effects for review.
abilities.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
abilities.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward.

abilities.name: Observe wildlife
abilities.function: Quietly observe an actually visible animal for two consecutive stationary rounds.
abilities.costs: Two consecutive stationary rounds, 0.5 energy each round and ordinary metabolism. Incompatible actions, insufficient energy, death or lost visibility cancel without refund.
abilities.effects: Retain only timestamped visible species, positions and behavior. A completed observation may activate registered nature appreciation: 3 for 12 rounds, 8-round cooldown; another rewarded completion within 24 rounds gives 1 with its own 12-round expiry. Overlapping awards use their maximum, never their sum. No animal control, movement, recovery or hidden knowledge.

satisfaction.name: Nature appreciation
satisfaction.rationale: Actual sustained perception of wildlife provides personal sensory engagement; no proposal, study or partial sample qualifies.

reviews.reason: Eating already applies real food effects, but it does not provide measured sampling, structured examination or evidence-qualified personal records. Those functions warrant development. Your current health permits assessment, and an owned root is available; its current condition must be checked at execution. Neither examination nor a small uneventful sample can establish that a food is generally safe. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: Examination can produce useful evidence but is not inherently enjoyable, and a harmful sample receives no mental award. Register cautious-food-relief on food-assessment-completed for the testing actor only: require completed sampling and monitoring, a genuinely new observation within that operation of experienced nourishment, no sample-associated injury or adverse symptoms, and no confounding food ingestion during the operation. The experience is modest relief from resolving a specific uncertainty, not proof of safety. Award 1 mental point, cap 1, lasting 6 rounds, with a 12-round cooldown; repeated qualifying assessments may refresh only after cooldown and never stack. Deduplicate this functional source across aliases. Application, learning, examination alone, labels and completion without qualifying evidence award nothing. Physical nutrition and harm remain independent and use actual state.
reviews.visualReview: Show stationary examination, a measured portion only when actually reserved or consumed, and monitoring progress tied to operation phases. Display dated evidence cards separating observed appearance, measured intake, experienced changes and unresolved uncertainty; never show a safe/unsafe badge or hidden toxicity value. Bind progress and cancellation to the declared assessment events, render only actor-visible information, and remove the active indicator on cancellation or death without deleting retained evidence.
reviews.specification: Implement food-assessment@1 through the current handoff, depending on inventory, metabolism, perception, event history and personal memory. Public interface assess-food has schema {target:string, mode:'examine'|'sample', fraction?:number}, additionalProperties:false; target identifies an owned stack, and sample requires fraction in [0.1,1], measured in resource units. Learning takes 3 rounds for sampling discipline and evidence interpretation, separately from implementation and use. Require living actor, health>=80, sufficient unspoiled-or-spoiled actual target quantity, stationary attention and 0.5 energy per work round; sample mode additionally requires satiety<=90 so nourishment is potentially observable. Examination takes two rounds and records only perceptible appearance, texture, odor and visible deterioration supported by implemented sensory properties; absent sensory support is recorded as unknown, never inferred from hidden nutrition/toxicity. Sample mode then consumes the specified fraction in round three through the existing food-effect resolver, charging 1 additional energy and applying proportional actual nutrition, toxicity and spoilage effects, followed by two stationary monitoring rounds at 0.5 energy each. Metabolism continues throughout. Persist operation ID, phase, target provenance, measured quantity, timestamps, sensory observations, baseline/follow-up vitals, relevant concurrent events and ingestion status. Record experienced changes with confounders; do not expose hidden composition, infer immunity, declare safety, or attribute unrelated changes to food. Reserve the sample at start using a unique escrow identity; it continues aging. Movement, incompatible action, insufficient energy, target invalidation or death cancels. Return unconsumed escrow once to inventory if alive, otherwise to the ordinary corpse/drop location; consumed material is never restored. Preserve completed observations after cancellation. Fractional inventory accounting must conserve mass and provenance: migrate integer quantities losslessly to fixed-point tenths, keep existing integer-quantity interfaces compatible, and leave remaining fractional portions accessible to assess-food. No stock is created. Owned-item interaction requires no remote world reach; use the actor's actual position and existing collision geometry, without moving objects or adding obstacles. Emit food-assessment-started, food-assessment-observed, food-assessment-sampled, food-assessment-completed and food-assessment-cancelled, with operation ID, participant, timestamps, provenance and public evidence; subscribe explicitly to died, moved, spoiled and injured for cancellation or evidence qualification. Add versioned bounded personal records, deduplicated by operation ID, with retention limits under shared state/work budgets. Migrate existing actors with empty assessment records and no active operations or retroactive awards.
